about:

Our beautifully designed property welcomes the students with fully furnished en suite studio and double rooms, giving each of them their own privacy and independency.   Not only bedrooms, but also many different communal spaces like gym, study areas, cinema and games rooms and our stunning rooftop swimming pools with an incredible view over the Barcelona skyline where the students will make those relationship which will last far beyond the university years.
 
Finally, there is much more than rooms and communal spaces;   Marina offers high valued services for a student like free high speed Wi-Fi, all-inclusive utility bills, bikes to rent, laundry, on site 24-hour security and maintenance team so that the student  can concentrate on what really matters – the student life experience.
 
Our location is also perfect to start discovering Barcelona;   within minutes you can go from the Olympic Village and beautiful beaches to Sagrada Familia or La Rambla.

name: Terrassa Can Telar
address: 60 Avinguda de Jaume I, Barcelona, Cataluña 08226
university: Escola Superior d’Enginyeries Industrial, Aeroespacial i Audiovisual de Terrassa
about:
Right in the heart of Terrassa, Can Telar offers students a modern, well-connected place to call home — just a 19-minute walk from UPC and 15 minutes from Hospital Universitari Mútua Terrassa. With easy access to both campuses and the vibrant city centre, it combines convenience with a lively student atmosphere.
Enjoy a range of top-tier amenities designed for both work and relaxation. Dedicated study rooms provide the perfect space to focus, while the gym, TV room and terrace give you places to unwind. The on-site cafeteria, dining room and swimming pool create a dynamic social setting, making it easy to meet new friends. For those who cycle, secure bike storage ensures peace of mind.
Beyond great facilities, Terrassa Can Telar offers all-inclusive bills, high-speed WiFi and a cleaning service every two weeks - including bed linen and towels - so you can focus on your studies without the hassle of everyday chores.
Terrassa Can Telar is more than just a place to stay; it's a supportive, welcoming community designed to make student life easier and more enjoyable. With everything you need at your fingertips, it is the ideal home for students who want comfort, convenience and a thriving social experience.

name: Alba Viu
address: Avinguda de la Ciència, Barcelona, Cataluña 08290
university: University of Southern California (Health Sciences Campus)
about:
Located in the vibrant area of Cerdanyola del Vallès, just a stone’s throw from the Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB) Campus Bellaterra, Alba Viu offers the perfect blend of comfort, coexistence, and community.
The area offers excellent transport links, with a bus stop located in front of the residence for easy access to UAB and a free shuttle bus service to the university, ensuring a smooth and convenient commute. If you’re looking to explore Barcelona, the city centre is only a short journey by train, giving you easy access to everything the city has to offer. Additionally, Alba Viu is closely located to the Synchrotron, a major scientific facility in Cerdanyola del Vallès, perfect for students and professionals involved in cutting-edge research.
At Alba Viu, we’ve designed spaces to make student life both productive and enjoyable. Choose from a variety of room options, including private studios or single rooms, to fit your personal lifestyle. You’ll have everything you need for both studying and relaxing, including dedicated study areas, a fully-equipped fitness studio, two swimming pools and a movie room. The dining room provides a great space to enjoy meals and socialise with fellow students.

name: Learn Spanish in 30 days ​with accomodation
about:
Welcome to Blau Language Study Package, where Spanish courses in Barcelona meet luxury living and cultural immersion. Our program offers a unique blend of language education and unforgettable experiences.
 
At Blau Language Academy, we provide a unique combination of Spanish courses, on-site accommodations, and immersive cultural activities. Our programs are designed for those who wish to learn Spanish while enjoying the vibrant city of Barcelona, whether you’re a digital nomad, traveler, or simply exploring life abroad.
【What Makes Blau Unique?】
1.Integrated Learning and Living
Our academy is located within a modern residential facility, offering over 200 rooms for students.
No commuting—live, study, and relax all in one place.
2.Exceptional Facilities
Access premium amenities, including:
•Fitness Center and Swimming Pool
•Co-working Spaces and Recording Studio
•Cinema and Sports Areas
•Social Spaces for Networking
Participate in free cultural activities, such as yoga classes, workshops, and weekly events to enhance your learning experience.
3.Group Accommodation Available
Ideal for schools, companies, or organized tours, with tailored group programs and on-site accommodation.
 
【Spanish Course Details】
Our programs are tailored to adults balancing work, travel, or cultural exploration:
1.Daily Spanish Classes
•Schedule: 1 hour per day, 7 days a week.
•Levels: Beginner (A1) to Upper-Intermediate (B2).
•Free Level Test: Start at the right level with our complimentary assessment.
•Private Lessons: Personalized one-on-one classes to meet your goals. [upon request]
•Completion Certificate: Receive an official certificate upon completing the program.
2.Flexible Programs for Every Lifestyle
•Digital Nomads: Balance Spanish lessons with remote work in a productive environment.
•Travel Enthusiasts: Live like a local while exploring Barcelona’s culture and lifestyle.
•Vacation Learners: Combine short-term travel with language learning during your holiday.
